div.div:
1. XOR Cancellation (Single Number):
x ^ x = 0 and x ^ 0 = x
XOR-ing an entire array cancels all pairs, leaving the unique element!

div.div:
2. Drop Lowest Set Bit (Brian Kernighan):
n = n & (n - 1)
Clears the rightmost 1 bit in O(1). Counting bits in O(set bits)!

3. Check if Kth bit is set:
(n & (1 << k)) !== 0
